overview_description.description:
OtterTune provides automated performance tuning solutions for data-intensive applications. It learns how the database behaves and continually tunes runtime knobs to improve the system’s performance. OtterTune discovers and reveals new approaches to optimization that most human DBAs can't detect. It makes the database backend run in the best possible scenario, now and in the future.

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

about_short_description.short_description: OtterTune is an automated perfector of databases.

product.name: Database Performance Optimization
product.description: OtterTune uses AI to automatically adjust database settings for improved performance on Amazon RDS and Aurora databases.

product.name: Database Health Monitoring
product.description: OtterTune monitors database health, providing scores based on best practices and optimizations.

product.name: Customizable Tuning Schedules
product.description: OtterTune allows users to set custom schedules for when database tuning recommendations are applied.

product.name: Performance Objective Optimization
product.description: Users can set specific performance objectives for OtterTune to optimize towards, such as query latency or CPU utilization.

product.name: Customizable Charts and Reports
product.description: OtterTune offers customizable reports and charts for over 100 metrics, allowing users to track database performance over time.
